charts.title: K2-415 b: orbits around K2-415
charts.description: The orbits of K2-415's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-415 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hirano et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..131H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HIRANO_ET_AL_2023): P 4.0179694 d

charts.title: K2-415 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-415 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 323687123, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
